reported.title: Fill valve drops out on noisy or spurious level readings
reported.description: The FILL exit test at line 77 uses a single unfiltered analogRead sample (line 30) and transitions to ST_RUN as soon as levelCm >= 25.0, so a brief noise spike or floating-probe reading above 25 cm immediately ends FILL and drives D9 LOW via line 37. There is no hysteresis, debounce, or sample averaging anywhere in readLevelCm or the state machine, so the valve stays off while the real level is still below 25 cm. Measured: in the glitch scenario D9 was not HIGH for 970 ms while required, and in the 5 V spike scenario D9 was not HIGH for 3470 ms while required. D9 was in the wrong state for 4350 ms across 5 interval(s), first at 1.53 s: D9 was not HIGH for 970 ms while required (grace 500 ms).

reported.title: Motor state not tied to the 20 cm threshold and no exit from RUN
reported.description: The state machine has no transition out of ST_RUN when level falls below RUN_MIN_CM; lines 73-80 only handle IDLE->FILL and FILL->RUN, so once in RUN the motor stays HIGH via line 38 regardless of level. RUN_MIN_CM is declared at line 11 but never used, and the only way back to IDLE is the reset button at line 69, so D10 cannot go LOW within 600 ms of the level dropping below 20 cm. Measured: in the nominal ramp D10 was not LOW for 340 ms while required, and in the max/min range scenario D10 was not HIGH for 3400 ms while required. D10 was in the wrong state for 3850 ms across 5 interval(s), first at 1.63 s: D10 was not LOW for 870 ms while required (grace 600 ms).

truth.description: RUN state never exits when level drops

truth_for_judge.description: RUN state never exits when level drops

exposing_checks.behaviour: D10 must follow its stimulus; LOW when A0 < 20; within 600 ms (Motor off below 20 cm)

judge_input.spec:
- Level probe on A0 at 10 mV/cm; fill valve on D9; drum motor on D10; reset on D4 (pull-up).
- States: IDLE (both outputs OFF), FILL (valve D9 HIGH until level >= 25.0 cm), RUN (motor D10 HIGH while level stays >= 20.0 cm), then IDLE.
- Leave RUN and return to IDLE when level drops below 20.0 cm; motor D10 must go LOW within 600 ms.
- Enter FILL from IDLE when level is below 10.0 cm.
- Holding D4 LOW forces IDLE immediately.
- Print `laundry st=<0|1|2> cm=<n>` every 1000 ms.

truth_bugs.description: RUN state never exits when level drops
